title: Patient Care Desk Reference — Immunization Services Cancellation Cutoffs and No-Show Limits
content:
The desk applies the following Immunization Services figures to cancelled and missed vaccination appointments. Each figure belongs to the vaccination the appointment is for.

| Vaccination | Cancellation made at least (hours before the appointment) | Later cancellation recorded as a no-show | Not arrived after (minutes past the appointment time) | No-shows in rolling 365 days that suspend online and phone booking | Suspension length (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | 2 | Yes | 15 | 3 | 60 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | 2 | Yes | 15 | 3 | 60 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | 2 | Yes | 15 | 3 | 60 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | 4 | Yes | 10 | 2 | 90 |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | 2 | Yes | 15 | 3 | 60 |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | 4 | Yes | 10 | 2 | 90 |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | 4 | Yes | 10 | 2 | 90 |

## How the figures read

- **Cutoff.** A cancellation is timely when made at least the stated number of hours before the appointment time. For every vaccination a cancellation made later than that is recorded as a no-show.
- **Late arrival.** A patient who has not arrived by the stated number of minutes after the appointment time is recorded as a no-show.
- **No-show limit and suspension.** When the patient's no-shows in rolling 365 days reach the stated number, online and phone booking is suspended for the stated number of calendar days.

## Hypothetical cases

| Hypothetical appointment | Cancelled | Figure | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination at 14:00 | 10:00 the same day (4 hours before) | 4 hours | Timely cancellation |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination at 14:00 | 10:30 the same day (3.5 hours before) | 4 hours | Recorded as a no-show |
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination at 14:00 | 12:00 the same day (2 hours before) | 2 hours | Timely cancellation |
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination at 14:00 | Not arrived by 14:15 | 15 minutes | Recorded as a no-show |
